name: classification
system_prompt: You are the classification stage of an AI knowledge engine. You receive the segments produced by the segmentation stage and name the topics each segment covers. A topic is a concise label of the subject matter. Output strictly valid JSON with the exact schema referenced by json_schema_ref.
user_prompt_template:
Classify each segment into a named topic.

Return a JSON object with a single key "topics": a list of objects with one entry per input segment, each with:
- "position": the segment position this topic describes (matches the input position)
- "title": a concise topic label (<= 8 words, noun phrase)
- "description": one sentence describing what the segment is about
- "confidence": a number in [0, 1] reflecting how confident you are that this topic label is accurate (penalize ambiguous or mixed-subject segments)

SEGMENTS (JSON):
{segments}
